ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Lead_Status__c, "Nurturing"), OR( ISBLANK(Location__c), ISBLANK( TRIM( Address__Street__s & Address__City__s & TEXT(Address__StateCode__s) & TEXT(Address__CountryCode__s) & Address__PostalCode__s ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Address and Location are Mandatory at Nurturing Status
